criteria.requirement: Add public immutable Options.from_mapping with declared body_width and common link/image/wrapping switches, and HTML2Text.from_options(options, *, out=None, baseurl="") integrated through the actual constructor/property conversion path. Reject unknown keys, nonbool switches, bool/noninteger/negative widths, conflicting image rendering modes and single_line_break with nonzero width in this explicit strict mode. Options detach input, expose independent as_dict copies and are reusable across independent converters. Preserve ordinary construction/dynamic property assignments, default byte output, custom out and baseurl. This task covers API strict configuration; do not claim unimplemented CLI integration or globally forbid legacy combinations.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
